summary: Elong Power Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the completion of a July 2026 offering of units and pre-funded units at $0.40 per unit, which triggered a downward adjustment of the exercise price of outstanding May 2026 Common Warrants from $1.30 to $0.2333 per share pursuant to anti-dilution provisions. The filing is a routine report of a follow-on equity offering and automatic warrant repricing, not a special situation event. No board recommendation, strategic review, or change in control is involved.
